heroText.title: Preaching the Word, wherever the church gathers
heroText.description: Sharing the Word of God with dedication and teaching the faith, prayer, and spiritual life of the congregation, helping believers grow stronger in their relationship with God.

campuses.description: Every Sunday, Priest James moves between three congregations — each with its own rhythm, but the same commitment to the Word.
